twm (Tab Window Manager) -- X.Org app/twm 1.0.13.1
Upstream:  https://www.x.org/releases/individual/app/twm-1.0.13.1.tar.xz
License:   X Consortium / MIT (COPYING in the extracted tree)

The tarball ships pre-generated gram.c / lex.c / deftwmrc.c so the build
has no bison / flex / shell dependency. Our overlay supplies:

  config.h
      Replaces the autoheader-produced config.h. Minimal HAVE_* set
      suitable for Emscripten; HAVE_XRANDR intentionally undefined
      (twm's randr code paths would pull in xrandr which we don't
      provide).

  generated/include/X11/SM/SMlib.h
      Header stub. session.h is #included transitively by twm.c,
      add_window.c and menus.c; it in turn pulls <X11/SM/SMlib.h>.
      The only SM symbol used in headers is the opaque SmcConn type,
      which the stub provides.

  generated/src/session_stub.c
      Replacement for upstream's session.c. X Session Management is
      irrelevant in a browser (no ICE/SM daemon, no .twmrc-session
      files), so each SessionInit / GetWindowConfig / ReadWinConfigFile
      / DestroySession entry is a no-op.

The real session.c that ships in the tarball is copied in but NOT
listed in demos/twm/CMakeLists.txt, so it never compiles.
